name: MEDTAS TPD / Drawing Assurance Module
design_principles: Native SOLIDWORKS 3D defines nominal geometry; the 2D production drawing defines/references allowable variation, functional relationships, material/process and inspection requirements.
No AutoDimension dump. Dimensions are selected from function/manufacturing/inspection intent.
Every release-critical characteristic gets a unique characteristic ID, source parameter, tolerance/fit/GD&T, view/section, and verification method.
Datums follow assembly function; fasteners that only clamp are not used as redundant radial datums.
Tolerance chains are solved before tolerances are frozen on the drawing.
Drawing PASS requires semantic completeness plus visual review; existence of PDF/SLDDRW is not PASS.
source_basis: Mechanical Tolerance Stackup and Analysis, chapters 2, 7, 9, 13-19

semantic: no missing tolerance/fit on release characteristic
visual: no dimension/note overlap at plotted scale
critical dimensions adjacent to relevant view or mapped to a feature table
release: drawing state RELEASED only after human visual approval + linter PASS + native PDF/SLDDRW pair

production_definition: native SOLIDWORKS SLDPRT/SLDASM under CAD configuration control
delivery_package.principle: Model and drawing are complementary authorities: model carries nominal topology/geometry; released drawing carries allowable variation, functional datum relationships, material/process/inspection requirements.

automatic_layout_policy.allowed: model dimensions deliberately MarkedForDrawing + explicit controlled release characteristics
automatic_layout_policy.layout: SOLIDWORKS initial placement followed by mandatory semantic lint and visual approval
automatic_layout_policy.fallback: If an API cannot create an unambiguous GD&T or feature callout reliably in SW2018, keep it as a controlled characteristic and hold drawing release until it is explicitly placed in native SLDDRW.

dimxpert_pipeline.authority_chain: controlled Product Characteristic ID -> native CAD semantic feature -> native SolidWorks DimXpert/PMI -> tolerance/stack-up analysis -> derived drawing -> inspection characteristic/result
dimxpert_pipeline.release_rule: A released tolerance/GD&T must not exist only as typed drawing text when an accepted native DimXpert/PMI or controlled semantic binding is required.
dimxpert_pipeline.P007_exemplar: Author/verify P007 native DimXpert/PMI before final K01-D-006 release; drawing is the derived projection.

bom_interlock.rule: Drawing title/revision/part identity and item quantity/reference data must resolve from the same controlled product registry/BOM baseline; drawings do not maintain a separate BOM truth.
bom_interlock.assembly_drawings: A001/D012 must refresh when modeled occurrence structure changes.
